b: I’ve been struggling with insomnia, and mirtazapine 7.5 mg has honestly been amazing for sleep. It helps me fall asleep and stay asleep, but the hunger is INSANE. 😭 I feel like I could eat everything in sight and still be hungry. The crazy part is that I’m also on semaglutide for weight loss, and even that doesn’t seem to help with the appetite increase from mirtazapine. I also have PCOS, so weight management is already a struggle, and I’m really worried about gaining weight.

My doctor also prescribed doxepin 3–6 mg and said I could try 6 mg to see if it works better for sleep. I’m curious if anyone has tried both mirtazapine and doxepin and noticed a difference in appetite or weight gain? Is doxepin generally more weight-neutral? And for those who’ve tried both 3 mg and 6 mg, did the higher dose make a noticeable difference in your sleep?

I’d also love to hear what other medications people have had success with for insomnia that don’t cause increased hunger or weight gain. It’s so frustrating because mirtazapine genuinely works so well for me, but I really don’t want to undo my weight loss progress just to be able to sleep. Has anyone else been in a similar situation? What ended up working for you?
